top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was no admission information available for children in care.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Daily Menus - May Rotate if Keep Record of Dates Menus Used (26 TAC §746.3313(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Menu's were observed and were not dated.

top_violation_types.title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One food allergy plan was not signed by the parent.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Provider could not provide annual training hours during inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Background Check Validation - Once a year listed family homes, licensed, and registered child care homes must validate list of subjects (26 TAC §745.651(2)(B))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the follow-up inspection the owner validation check was not done.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child in care did not have an immunization record available for review.
